metric: KLM-predicted time from opening the app to completing the basic flight (s)
finding: Feasible, but tight: 203.9 s of the 300 s budget goes on sign-up, log-in, the full tutorial and calibration before the first take-off. With a x2 allowance for a first-time user the estimate is 439.6 s, over the limit, so the real-participant timing (QR-45) is the deciding evidence. Shortening the path (skippable tutorial steps, calibration offered after the first flight) would add margin.
method: Keystroke-Level Model (Card, Moran & Newell): K=0.28, P=1.10, B=0.10, H=0.40, M=1.35 s. Form fields, tutorial clip lengths, calibration sequence and window are read from the product itself; system response times come from this run. An error-free prediction: a feasibility check, confirmed or refuted by QR-45.
